items.content_html: Unsupervised anomaly detection for James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) images. It tiles MIRI and NIRCam FITS mosaics, embeds them with DINOv3 or DINOv2, and ranks tiles by patch distance (AnomalyDINO) to surface odd galaxies and artifacts without labels.
